title: Case X (Serial 1119.00): illustrations of dirty metallic elliptical object, May 24, 1949
description: Two shaded illustrations of an elongated, elliptical metallic object with a raised bump at the rear and arrows showing direction of motion. The lower drawing carries callouts: "Something equivalent to a patch", "Smoother in front", "Rough and wrinkled in rear", "Surface appeared dirty and spotty in color" and "Direction of motion". Typed text above describes a sighting by employees of an aeronautical laboratory's supersonic lab observed with 8-power binoculars for 2-1/2 to 3 minutes. Page numbered 86.
